name: spin-punch-cf2
description: CF2/ZD2808 variant of spin-punch-15-2k: cruise at 1.0 A instead of 0.3 - the CF2 current sense (0.5 mOhm x10 = 161 mA/LSB, ia noise sigma ~0.5 A) cannot regulate a 0.3 A command; 2026-07-07 bench: 0.3 A cruise collapsed at t+0.6 s into a frozen-observer coast (see TODO).
